Hi Mariana / MarketBid onboarding team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process — excited to get MarketBid set up as a Redwood supplier. To get the PO flow enabled from our finance system and avoid payment delays, we need the following from you: 

- Official VAT registration certificate (image/pdf) showing VAT number and effective date.
- A signed tax residency attestation or equivalent (country-specific form) so we can determine withholding/tax treaty status.
- Examples of the invoice format you will send to us (PDF or UBL/UBL-XML sample).
- Confirmation of the legal entity that should be mapped to our PO (registered company name exactly as on invoices). If you operate multiple entities in the EU please indicate which one will receive Redwood POs.

Quick clarifying question: will MarketBid be billing under a Portuguese VAT-registered entity for B2B sales to Redwood, or do you expect a VAT reverse-charge treatment (i.e., will our PO be to an EU entity with VAT number, and you will issue net invoices with reverse charge noted)? This affects our PO tax coding.

If you can attach the VAT cert and the sample invoice, procurement can draft the PO mapping and finance will kick off activation. We generally need these docs to be uploaded to the shared Drive link below for audit.

Next steps: once we have the docs, I'll loop in Finance (Laura) for PO number assignment and Karthik for the vendor tax mapping. 

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOnboardingDocs

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Thanks, Mariana — quick technical follow-ups from procurement/tax mapping: 

1) Invoice remit entity: please confirm the exact pay-to/legal name you want on PO and invoices (MarketBid Portugal Lda is fine, but please provide the full legal address you want used for the PO).
2) VAT number format: please confirm the VAT number as it appears on the cert (we need the country prefix + digits; e.g., PT123456789).
3) Invoice currency: will you invoice Redwood in EUR or GBP (we're EUR preferred for EU contracts)?
4) Do you already include the standard EU reverse-charge wording on your invoices? If possible paste the line you add so our AP parser can validate.
5) Any payment terms exceptions (Net30 default) or specific remittance bank details we should add to the PO?

Once we have these, finance will map the vendor in the system and create PO template. Laura — FYI on the attestation PDF — if finance needs a notarized copy we'll request that as a follow-up.

Thanks,
